scope: All 100 initial paired overview photos visually inspected; crop-v2 uses source-only metadata and unchanged colors. Not native fine-detail/preference acceptance.
observations: Urban/forest/flower examples often gain contrast and stronger palette; Expert C is not consistently restrained.

Indoor bedroom/candle portrait/night architecture show substantial white-balance shifts; RAW camera-WB inputs differ from already processed phone JPEGs.

Stronger greens/pinks/cyan skies and altered contrast cannot alone define user preference or minimal-control feasibility.
